text: Hazardous areas shall be classified per IEC 60079-10-1 in the hazardous area classification report and drawings (ALP-EPC-00000-HS-HAZ-0008), based on the properties of the fuel gas (DP-OWNR-0024 to DP-OWNR-0032), the LDO, hydrogen for the generators, aqueous ammonia and battery hydrogen. Electrical equipment shall be selected accordingly and certified (ATEX 2014/34/EU, IECEx) for the zone, gas group and temperature class.
